label: Помнить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for помнить (to remember, keep in mind).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Помню' is the -ю form of imperfective помнить, describing a state held in mind. 'Этот день' is the accusative object kept in memory.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Помнишь' shows the -ишь ending of помнить. The verb names an ongoing state rather than a single event, which is why the imperfective fits.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Помнит' is the core -ит form of помнить. 'Каждое слово' stresses the completeness of an ongoing memory.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Помним' takes the -им ending. 'Наших старых учителей' is an animate accusative, matching the genitive-like plural form.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Помните' is the respectful -ите form of помнить. 'Дорогу до вокзала' is the accusative object of a practical question.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Помнят' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending. 'Ещё' stresses that the memory still holds.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Помнил' is the masculine -л past, describing a memory held over time. The imperfective is natural for such a continuous state.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Помнила' adds the feminine -ла ending. 'Долго' underlines the lasting nature of the remembered conversation.
Strategic focus: Imperfective future. 'Буду' is the auxiliary and 'помнить' stays infinitive in the compound future. The imperfective stresses a continuing future state of remembering.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Помни' is the informal command of помнить. 'О своём обещании' uses о with the prepositional case to name what should stay in mind.
